meta.title: Military bases
meta.source: USDOT/BTS National Transportation Atlas Database (NTAD) Military Bases, plus notable non-overlapping bases from Wikidata
meta.license: NTAD: work of the U.S. government, public domain (17 U.S.C. § 101). Wikidata: CC0.
meta.filter: NTAD: operational (act), not CUI, unique site name (largest polygon), all overseas sites plus the 280 largest U.S. sites. Wikidata: instance of military base (Q245016), airbase (Q695850) or naval base (Q1324633) with ≥8 Wikipedia sitelinks; dropped if within 30 km of an NTAD site.
meta.note: Not a complete inventory of all military facilities. NTAD covers publicly released U.S. DoD sites worldwide. Other countries come from well-documented Wikidata items only.
meta.attribution: U.S. Department of Transportation, Bureau of Transportation Statistics, National Transportation Atlas Database (Military Bases); Wikidata contributors (CC0)
